title: Iniciar sesión
rules: Retain JWT; five failed attempts block account; verify current persisted status on every request.

title: Cerrar sesión
rules: Retain 204 and idempotent signed revoked token; add logout timestamp audit, never log token.

title: Cambiar contraseña
rules: Verify previous Argon2id; policy >=12 chars <=200, at least one letter and digit; revoke all refresh sessions atomically with password update.

title: Restablecer contraseña
rules: Admin only; CSPRNG 24-char temporary password shown once, never audit; must change before clinical access; revoke sessions, clear failed counter.

title: Administrar usuarios y roles
rules: Create/update/deactivate through explicit action upsert with optional id; role allowlist; may not deactivate last active administrator; no password/hash in DTO.

title: Consultar bitácora
rules: Admin/auditor only; stable time/id paging; append-only; restricted reads/writes audited without clinical content.

title: Buscar paciente
rules: Preserve baseline literal search, active filter, scoped document uniqueness.

title: Registrar paciente nuevo
rules: Preserve atomic patient+expediente+required guardian.

title: Actualizar datos del paciente
rules: Allow identity/contact edits except generated ids, institution, state and registration time; validate document uniqueness and no future birth; return only identity to reception.

title: Registrar contacto de emergencia
rules: Atomic replace principal flag on other contacts when adding a new principal; validate ownership.

title: Registrar responsable o tutor
rules: Keep inline atomic registration, not a new orphan patient workflow; later guardian addition uses contacts-style child write while exactly one principal remains.

title: Consultar ficha del paciente
rules: Clinical role sees identity+allergies+antecedents, reception gets only baseline identity; never grant reception clinical field access.

title: Abrir expediente
rules: Retain registration transaction and one record per patient; not a second opening route.

title: Consultar historial completo
rules: Merge all local clinical events including specialty, attachments, admissions, notes, exams, dental, growth and vaccines; timestamp desc then type then id; bridge results only after delivery.

title: Registrar antecedentes
rules: Append, source types personal/familiar/quirurgico/habito; no future start date; no clinical DELETE.

title: Registrar alergia
rules: Unique normalized substance per expediente; severity leve/moderada/severa, reference rules from schema.

title: Adjuntar documento
rules: PDF/JPEG/PNG magic and MIME, max 10MiB, stream SHA256, generated local path; authorized download GET /api/documentos/:id/contenido; cleanup orphan temp files on failure.

title: Archivar expediente
rules: Keep archive behavior; reject active admissions or open consultations with conflict instead of corrupting state.

title: Reactivar expediente
rules: Administrator only; clear archive metadata but append old values to safe audit; never erase history.

title: Consultar disponibilidad
rules: UTC intervals, <=31 days; 08:00-17:00 Guatemala Mon-Sat, 30min default; explicit academic configurable hours not claimed source fact.

title: Agendar cita
rules: Lock scoped professional/day; reject overlapping non-cancelled/non-no_asistio intervals, not only identical start.

title: Reprogramar cita
rules: Release prior and reserve new interval atomically; injected mid-write failure restores old slot.

title: Cancelar cita
rules: Keep record; cancelled interval becomes reusable, never delete.

title: Registrar llegada
rules: Source has no llegada enum; map arrival to confirmada; duplicate arrival idempotent confirmed, attended/cancelled rejected.

title: Ver agenda del día
rules: Convert Guatemala day bounds to UTC half-open interval; role-safe projection omits motivo for nonclinical viewers.

title: Abrir consulta
rules: Persist open consultation+draft, optional owned confirmed appointment; keep baseline atomic closed shortcut unchanged.

title: Registrar signos vitales
rules: Enfermeria/medico only; one row per consultation; bounds source §5.1; no BMI persisted.

title: Registrar diagnóstico
rules: Store draft only with expected_revision; validate one primary; final normalized children only at close.

title: Registrar tratamiento
rules: Use diagnosis_index and expected_revision; diagnostic links validated at close; retained baseline enums.

title: Emitir receta
rules: Validate active medications; final issued prescription and folio only when close commits; draft preview explicitly labeled not issued.

title: Cerrar consulta
rules: Atomically close persisted draft, children, prescription and consultation charge; extend baseline shortcut to charge in same native transaction too; mark linked appointment atendida.

title: Anular consulta
rules: Append reason/user/time, retain all clinical children; reject if consultation cargo already invoiced until invoice annulled; cancel only pending generated charges atomically.

title: Consultar recetas del paciente
rules: Include issue date and annulled markers, medication detail and clinician; no fabricated interaction detection.

title: Consultar camas disponibles
rules: Only libre scoped beds ordered service/id; show service tariff public values.

title: Registrar ingreso
rules: Lock expediente+bed; one active admission per record and bed; active expediente; owned ingreso diagnosis; admission+occupied bed atomic.

title: Escribir nota de evolución
rules: Append-only, required ADMISION FK; correction references prior note in same admission, original content immutable.

title: Registrar procedimiento
rules: Exactly one admission/consultation anchor; create procedure+team+consumption+charges atomically through shared ports, rollback on missing lot/stock.

title: Registrar egreso
rules: Strictly later than ingreso; owned diagnosis; free bed and bill max(1,ceil(elapsed_hours/24)) days at snapshotted current bed tariff atomically.

title: Solicitar estudio al laboratorio
rules: Local PG order+outbox commit; local worker imports lab order idempotently with explicit approved referral scope; never synchronous distributed transaction.

title: Registrar antecedentes de nacimiento
rules: Source §5.3 ranges, versioned audit on correction; active record required.

title: Registrar medición de crecimiento
rules: Compute age at measurement and WHO LMS percentiles/Z from pinned verified reference, store version and historical values; no synthetic WHO table.

title: Ver curva de crecimiento
rules: Chronological actual measurements SVG chart with WHO reference overlay; no line interpolation that pretends unmeasured data.

title: Consultar esquema de vacunación
rules: Idempotent scheduled dose creation from versioned explicit dose interval catalog; pending/overdue derived relative to clock, not invented dates.

title: Registrar dosis aplicada
rules: Validate dose <= catalog total; nonfuture date >= birth, required lot/professional; apply+update schedule atomically, repeated command idempotent.

title: Registrar reacción adversa
rules: Only applied dose accepts reaction, append safe audit, preserve lot and application date.

title: Evaluar hitos de desarrollo
rules: Show expected catalog milestones by age; upsert reached flag with date/observations and immutable audit of previous evaluation.

title: Listar dosis pendientes
rules: Pending dates <= requested day, patient contact role-filtered, stable page; no automatic patient outreach.

title: Recibir orden de examen
rules: One or more active exam codes; idempotent external origin/reference; referred patient mapped by explicit referral link not coincident numeric id.

title: Registrar toma de muestra
rules: Unique barcode, ordered exam-compatible sample, inadequate sample stored but cannot validate result.

title: Cargar resultado
rules: Discriminated exam schema, correct sample/order, automatic reference flags and preliminary result+order state atomic; one current result per ordered exam.

title: Validar resultado
rules: Authorized professional distinct? no source mandates distinct operator, allow qualified validator; when all ordered exams valid, order becomes validada atomically.

title: Comparar contra valores de referencia
rules: Also automatic inside OP50; sex/age interval [min,max), one matching range per numeric analyte; fail missing/ambiguous references, store reference snapshot.

title: Entregar resultado
rules: Only all validated; local order+delivery outbox atomic; result available at referring hospital after idempotent receipt, not before.

title: Consultar historial de exámenes
rules: All owned exam results with preliminary/validated/rectified status; origin only receives delivered snapshot.

title: Abrir odontograma
rules: Create exactly 32 permanent FDI teeth (quadrants1..4 positions1..8) with sane surfaces, no 19/29/39/49; one chart per submitted command.

title: Actualizar estado de una pieza
rules: Per-surface status map allows obturada oclusal+caries mesial simultaneously; expected revision prevents lost updates.

title: Elaborar plan de tratamiento
rules: Nonempty ordered procedure/tooth lines with snapshot price; calculate total, stable line ids, max100 lines, no user supplied total.

title: Aceptar plan de tratamiento
rules: Source OP says in-progress, schema also aceptado: audit proposed->accepted->in-progress in one transaction; immutable accepted budget.

title: Registrar sesión de tratamiento
rules: Validate performed plan lines not repeated; session+line completion+procedure charges atomic; completed all marks finalizado.

title: Consultar saldo del paciente
rules: Budget, performed/billed, paid and remaining separately; join real billing port, never equate session count with payment.

title: Administrar personal
rules: Keep locked PROFESIONAL B; separate 1:1 contrato table stores category/contract/start; conditional colegiado, no forbidden columns on profesional.

title: Definir tarifa de honorarios
rules: Honorarios type only, no planilla; lock professional+service; nonoverlapping [desde,hasta) version windows; cannot mutate historical tariffs.

title: Registrar el equipo de una atención
rules: Exactly one consultation/procedure, unique role+professional+act; scoped professional.

title: Calcular honorarios de un acto
rules: Snapshot tariff at act time times role factor; percentage of service price; persist amount+idempotent honorario charge in same transaction, never recalculate history silently.

title: Liquidar honorarios de un período
rules: Monthly report by professional/act/role, RRHH all; clinical self only; no actual bank payouts.

title: Registrar consumo de material
rules: Atomic consumption+stock decrement+charge; positive integer quantity while source stock INT; controlled/requires_lote needs lot; one or zero act anchors with explicit patient.

title: Consultar existencias
rules: Low-stock academic threshold <=5 configurable seed metadata, actual counts; public projection excludes cost to unauthorized role.

title: Generar cargo
rules: Shared application port reused inside close/exit/consume/honoraria/dental; unique source event key, snapshot price; manual charges authorized caja only.

title: Consultar cargos pendientes
rules: Only pendiente, safe projection no clinical origin FKs/descriptions, generic service label for reception.

title: Anular o marcar cortesía un cargo
rules: Caja with explicit cargo.autorizar permission only; reason audited, invoiced rejects.

title: Consultar tarifario
rules: Institution tariff read, no private contract honoraria, active service list.

title: Seleccionar cargos a facturar
rules: Nonempty unique owned pending ids, compute immutable snapshot preview hash; preview does not reserve or mutate cargo, revalidate at issue.

title: Emitir factura
rules: Native atomic invoice+lines+mark cargos+transactional series counter, gapless successful commits; 12% IVA taxable discounted base; no real FEL call.

title: Registrar pago
rules: Lock invoice, amount<=balance, nonannulled, charge+balance+state atomic; idempotency required; card is simulated method label no PAN capture/provider.

title: Anular factura
rules: Mark invoice+all payments annulled, balance0, cargo anulado, retain sequence forever; no automatic real refunds.

title: Consultar estado de cuenta
rules: Actual invoices/payments/balances; patient role requires bound patient id, otherwise no self access; clinician sees balance only not payments.

title: Cierre de caja
rules: Guatemala day aggregate nonannulled payments by method; include annulation totals separately, no fictitious fiscal submission.
